checks.description: Its statuses (Appendix C.1 #28, #29): every problem the bill rules find in its content (a missing rate aside, which a draft takes when it posts), as Templates incomplete (✖); a warning when an occurrence before today has no draft yet; or OK, Paused or Ended.

content_version.description: The version of its content, which drafts name; it changes when the supplier, currency, lines, notes or nature of payment change.

edited_at.description: When the current content was written.

edited_by.description: Who wrote the current content: they do not approve the posting of its drafts (SOD-3).

last_on.description: The last occurrence a draft was made for.

nature_of_payment.description: What each draft's payment is for, for a supplier resident outside Singapore (FR-AP-19).

next_on.description: The next occurrence the scheduler makes a draft bill for, dated that day; absent once it has ended.

status.description: active makes its drafts; paused makes none until it is resumed; ended has no occurrence left.

supplier.description: The supplier of each draft, with its name.

total.description: Each draft's total: every line's net and GST, in its currency.

version.description: The version of the recurring bill; it makes the ETag.
